answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 66912 Country: India Title: Having doubt in Islamic beliefs Question: My question is that if someone having doubt in Islamic beliefs like Day of Judgment, Prophet, Heaven, Hell. Will he turn into a kafir? If yes, then what should he do now? Answer ID: 66912 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1136/1215/L=11/1437) These are the fundamental beliefs, it is necessary to have firm belief in them. If someone has doubt then he should read لاحول ولا قوۃ الا باللہ and renew his faith by reciting Kalimah and must say that he is believing in these things without any doubt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
